title: Pushforward description of each concrete module-sheaf Cech term
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a type in its universe, $U:I\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ any family and $F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $D$ be the concrete complex of [def-pc-cech-module-sheaf-functor]. For every $p\in\mathbb N$, there is an isomorphism of module sheaves $D^p\simeq\prod_{y:\mathrm{Fin}(p+1)\to I} j_{y,*}(F|_{\bigcap_l U(y(l))})$, where $j_y$ is the open immersion of the indicated finite intersection into $X$. This includes empty $I$ and does not require a cover.

source.place: Proof, paragraph 1, together with the displayed Cech term and augmentation

proof.text: Use P and D of [def-pc-cech-module-sheaf-functor]. Compose overPushforwardOverAdj with the equivalence of module sheaves on the over site and the open subscheme. Transport the left adjoint by Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv. Both this adjunction and Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction have left adjoint restriction, so Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq identifies their right adjoints. Evaluate this natural isomorphism on the equivalence image of F.over W, and compose with the equivalence unit and the mapped overFunctorEquiv component. This gives P(W) isomorphic to scheme pushforward of F restricted to W.

For a finite family V of opens, the product maps to its infimum by le_iInf of its projections. The inverse is Pi.lift of the infimum inclusions. Both inverse identities hold because opens are a thin category. Apply P contravariantly to this isomorphism for every tuple y, then compose with the preceding pushforward identification at the infimum.

The degree-p object of D is definitionally the product of P at each tuple product. Pi.mapIso of the component isomorphisms gives the asserted term isomorphism. The universal property applies also when the tuple index type is empty.

theorem cechModuleSheafComplex_term_iso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((cechModuleSheafComplex U F).X p ≅ ∏ᶜ fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ι =>
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι).obj
        (F.restrict (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι))
